items.title: Topological invariance of the etale site restricts to the small etale sites of schemes and of affine schemes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: In the situation of the chapter's topological invariance theorem (a universal submersive integral universally injective morphism X -> Y), the equivalence of big etale topoi Y_spaces_etale -> X_spaces_etale restricts to equivalences on the small etale sites Y_etale -> X_etale and on the affine etale sites Y_affine_etale -> X_affine_etale. The retained proof is written out: the claim is exactly that an object V of Y_spaces_etale is a scheme (resp. affine scheme) if and only if V x_Y X is; the base change V x_Y X -> V is integral, universally injective and surjective as a base change of X -> Y, so the assertion follows from the Limits of Spaces lemma that being a scheme descends along integral universally bijective maps and the proposition that affineness descends there. Retained author proof at lines 1424-1433.
